schematic_notes.text:
USB-C CONTROLLER SOCKETS
J1 = vendor P1; J2 = vendor P2. USB end faces carrier top.
22.86 mm between rows. Socket pin 1 is at antenna end.

RADIO A SOCKETS
Top view: upper row module pins 8..1 left to right; lower 9..16.
Antennas connect to module IPEX4 ports at right.

RADIO B SOCKETS
Same wiring and orientation as Radio A.
Both sockets support either band and modulation.

POWER
USB_5V is controller P1.21, downstream of its D1 diode.
U1 output is separate from controller 3V3 pins.
No external power input. Radio allowance 300 mA.
Validate USB allowance, controller D1 heat, and voltage drop.

FIRMWARE
CS defaults high. Reset and initialize both radios at boot.
Wait for each BUSY low before commands. One CS active at a time.
Start SPI at 2 MHz. DIO11 is a radio pin name, not ESP32 GPIO11.
Keep Wi-Fi/Bluetooth off for initial RF tests.

RADIO CONTACTS
RF header pins 1 and 16 and NC pin 6 have no carrier traces.
DIO7 and DIO8 are reserved and unconnected in this revision.
Manufacturer pinout image is an underside view.
Socket numbering here follows the documented TOP view.

ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE
Native KiCad ERC/DRC and sample socket-fit checks pending.
No hardware or radio performance has been validated.
Do not substitute generic LM/AMS1117 for ceramic-stable TLV1117LV.
